resolvedQuestions.question: How do the current chart cards compare with strong reference card anatomy, hierarchy and spacing?
resolvedQuestions.answer: The shared five-part card register is strong. A narrowly scoped metric-and-delta treatment remains worth investigating for scalar and time-series forms.

resolvedQuestions.question: Which mark treatments are genuinely missing or weak after the shipped phases 15 to 19?
resolvedQuestions.answer: The shipped register is coherent. Add per-form sparse-dot and meaningful-zero signed-area policies, while retaining current line weight, flat stack separators, gap handling and baseline-anchored columns.

resolvedQuestions.question: Which tooltip, legend and interaction patterns improve reading without adding decoration?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Keep the shipped tooltip geometry, table fallback, below-plot legend and reversible dimming. Add per-series tooltip indicator shapes, permit data-backed contextual totals, and earn cursor guides only for dense multi-series forms.

resolvedQuestions.question: Which colour and dark-ground changes are numerically safe under the cursor register and its gates?
resolvedQuestions.answer: The current cursor palette is numerically safe. Preserve the three systems, their independent dark values and role semantics, and use existing tokens for future scoped additions.

resolvedQuestions.question: Which missing micro-forms earn a place, and which enforceable rules belong in the checker?
resolvedQuestions.answer: Add one spark capability with line, area and bar variants, plus tracker and bar-list. Keep KPI delta as optional anatomy, retain the existing progress and countable-ring answers, and enforce stable shared contracts while leaving question-fit and visual judgement per-template.

keyFindings.title: Shared five-part card register is already coherent
keyFindings.description: Headline, subtitle, figure, footer finding and source are ordered and visibly separated.

keyFindings.title: Optional metric and delta are the credible anatomy gap
keyFindings.description: References foreground a scalar or period delta where the generic time-series card foregrounds narrative text.

keyFindings.title: Global spacing should stay stable
keyFindings.description: The 760px card, shared padding and 480px figure floor are deliberate while plot geometry is per form.

keyFindings.title: Conclusion headlines should remain
keyFindings.description: The corpus headline and footer carry interpretation rather than only chart type labels.

keyFindings.title: Dashboard chrome is out of standalone scope
keyFindings.description: Controls and toolbars are product context, not a universal delivery-card part.

keyFindings.title: Shipped line, area and bar register is coherent
keyFindings.description: The current 2px line, restrained single-area fade, flat separated stack and baseline-anchored columns cover common questions without a global mark reset.

keyFindings.title: Sparse series need an explicit point policy
keyFindings.description: Transparent hit circles preserve interaction but hide point density. A per-form sparse-dot policy is useful, while dense daily lines should remain dotless by default.

keyFindings.title: Signed area around a meaningful zero is missing
keyFindings.description: The current area closes every run to one baseline treatment. A signed form should split positive and negative fills only when zero is semantically meaningful.

keyFindings.title: Flat separated stack fills should remain
keyFindings.description: The existing 0.4 fills, 2px surface separators and four-series capacity guard keep composition and identity distinct. A universal gradient would add ambiguity.

keyFindings.title: Baseline-anchored column geometry is correct
keyFindings.description: Rounding only the free end preserves quantitative contact with the baseline. Fully rounded reference bars do not justify changing this default.

keyFindings.title: Curve, label and density choices belong to individual forms
keyFindings.description: Smooth curves, in-band labels, grouped bars and dense monochrome areas are valid specialized variants but should not become global defaults or new catalog families without a question.

keyFindings.title: Shipped tooltip geometry is contract-strong
keyFindings.description: The HTML card is bounded, palette-driven, positioned against the mark, initialized empty and wired to the same readout values as the table.

keyFindings.title: Contextual headers and totals should be optional
keyFindings.description: Formatter, unit and total rows help when the data contract supplies them, but should not become decorative tooltip chrome.

keyFindings.title: Mixed mark types need truthful tooltip indicators
keyFindings.description: The shared square indicator hides the composed chart's line-versus-column distinction that the legend already carries.

keyFindings.title: Dimming and pointer reach are reversible and bounded
keyFindings.description: 0.3 non-selected opacity, empty initial state, latch reset, keyboard controls and REACH 36 support comparison without changing the settled picture.

keyFindings.title: Below-plot legend placement is the correct small-card default
keyFindings.description: The current below-plot 16px-gap row matches compact area references, while Carbon's side legend and panel serve larger compositions.

keyFindings.title: Cursor guides should be earned by dense multi-series forms
keyFindings.description: A guide or active marker can anchor a crowded x position, but the default tooltip remains legible without a permanent guide.

keyFindings.title: The stock palette clears both-theme numeric gates with narrow margins
keyFindings.description: The lowest light categorical and neutral mark ratios are 3.02:1 and 3.01:1, while the light ordered adjacent separation is 1.30:1. The corresponding dark minima also clear their gates.

keyFindings.title: Dark palette blocks are explicit theme values, not reversed light arrays
keyFindings.description: The dark ground uses explicit neutral, ordered and categorical values with measured dark-surface ratios rather than a byte-reversed light palette.

keyFindings.title: Role-based colour should remain separate from a raw shadcn blue family
keyFindings.description: The recorded comparison supports the cursor's neutral, ordered and categorical role split instead of adding another blue family with weaker reported separation.

keyFindings.title: Rule is structural and remains outside mark contrast gates
keyFindings.description: Light rule is #CDCDC9 and dark rule is #F7F7F417, or 9.02 percent alpha. Separators and tooltip borders should reuse structural roles rather than become data colours.

keyFindings.title: Ordered ramps are the only supported multi-step sweep
keyFindings.description: The ordered ramp clears its two-theme step and endpoint gates, while categorical colour remains unordered and should not be turned into a magnitude sweep.

keyFindings.title: Reference screenshots do not provide admissible external token values
keyFindings.description: The local Carbon, Apple, Vercel and Observable captures provide rendered pixels but no external hex or RGB token table, so they cannot justify a new contrast-tested token.

keyFindings.title: The missing frontier is compact capability, not full-size catalog coverage
keyFindings.description: The 26 current rows cover the principal quantitative question families, while the local references expose compact monitoring and context forms that are not represented as catalog rows.

keyFindings.title: Spark earns one capability with line, area and bar variants
keyFindings.description: The compact trend role is distinct from the full daily-line form, but its three marks should share one spark question rather than become unrelated gaps.

keyFindings.title: Tracker earns a discrete status-over-time form
keyFindings.description: Equal status blocks answer whether each period was healthy, missing or exceptional, distinct from a numeric daily line and a full-year quantity grid.

keyFindings.title: Bar-list earns a compact ranked-list variant
keyFindings.description: In-bar labels and right-edge values create a compact density contract for long names while preserving the existing comparison semantics.

keyFindings.title: KPI delta belongs to optional card anatomy
keyFindings.description: A primary value and meaningful baseline delta can improve a form whose data supplies them, but goal progress and countable part-to-whole already have honest forms.

keyFindings.title: Existing checker assertions cover the stable shared contract
keyFindings.description: Document, card, geometry, palette, data, catalog and interaction assertions can catch concrete drift in new forms, including missing parts, failed theme gates, index drift, prefilled cards and unreachable marks.

keyFindings.title: Only explicit new contracts justify new checker assertions
keyFindings.description: A mark-policy declaration could cover point, curve, fill and meaningful-zero intent, and a tooltip-indicator declaration could match indicator kind to mark kind, while question-fit remains review judgement.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Universal KPI tabs, toolbar, minimap or product-context header inside every standalone delivery card.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The references show these in application compositions while the contract defines one chart card and a separate table as the delivery unit.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Global increase to card padding, card width or card radius based only on larger reference crops.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The current measurements are deliberate and the contract makes plot geometry per form.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Global visible points on every line and area.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The current daily line intentionally uses transparent circles as hit regions and reserves the visible point for the emphasized datum; references present dots as a variant for sparse or point-oriented data.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Universal smooth interpolation or gradient fills for stacked composition.
ruledOutDirections.reason: Curve and fill choices carry data meaning. A smooth or gradient stack could imply values between observations and compete with series identity.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Rounding the baseline end of quantitative columns.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The baseline is the measurement anchor, so the free-end-only path keeps the column in contact with its scale.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Adding LayerChart, Unovis or another external mark family to the catalog solely because the library contains it.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The question-first catalog already maps the shipped forms and reserves specialized missing-form decisions for the final angle.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Global tooltip padding, radius, shadow or width restyle.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The current 128px floor, 6px by 10px padding, bounded placement and table-backed readout already satisfy the interaction contract.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Icons in every tooltip.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The icon reference is a specialized label treatment and the current swatch or rule can carry series identity with less visual noise.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Moving every legend above or beside the plot.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The contract and compact examples support below-plot legends, while alternate positions belong to larger compositions.

ruledOutDirections.direction: A permanent cursor guide on every form.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The default tooltip works without a guide, and a guide only earns its space when x-position ambiguity is demonstrated.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Treating legend click and legend hover as the same state without an explicit contract decision.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The current code wires legend click and keyboard latch but no pointerenter or pointerleave preview, so the two states are observably different.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Replacing the cursor palette with a raw shadcn blue set.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The local numeric comparison does not show a safer result for the raw blue family, while the current role systems clear their gates.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Reversing the light arrays to make the dark theme.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The dark palette is authored as separate values against its own surface and has its own measured ratios.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Adding a new unmeasured external palette token from Carbon, Apple, Vercel or Observable screenshots.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The local captures do not expose source token values and screenshot pixels are not enough to identify a safe token.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Using the structural rule role as a data mark.
ruledOutDirections.reason: Rule is intentionally ungated and is reserved for low-contrast structure rather than marks that carry data.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Adding categorical multi-step sweeps.
ruledOutDirections.reason: A sweep encodes magnitude or position, which conflicts with categorical semantics and the ordered-only sweep contract.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Adding progress-circle or radial-ring as new catalog questions solely from gauge and ring imagery.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The current progress-single and unit-ring forms cover the existing questions, while the inspected radial captures do not add a distinct data contract.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Treating KPI delta as a sixth universal card part or a standalone chart id.
ruledOutDirections.reason: Metric and delta are useful only when a data-backed baseline exists, so they belong to optional anatomy around an existing chart question.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Adding three unrelated catalog rows for spark line, spark area and spark bar.
ruledOutDirections.reason: The references present the marks as variants of one compact trend role, not three independent reader questions.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Replacing bar-rows comparison semantics with a new palette or external implementation merely to reproduce a bar-list capture.
ruledOutDirections.reason: Bar-list changes label placement and compact density while preserving the comparison question and existing colour contract.

ruledOutDirections.direction: Making the checker judge headline quality, guide density, metric eligibility or radial worth.
ruledOutDirections.reason: Those choices require question and visual review, and the contract explicitly excludes headline and by-eye picture judgement from static assertions.
